issue.title: Bead link_added/link_removed events always record the store owner as actor, so link writes are unattributable
issue.description:
PROPOSED BY epic sase-14j ("Beads sub-section in the agent metadata panel's ARTIFACTS lane"), whose plan's "Memory and follow-ups" section asked its land agent to file this attribution defect. Found while designing the agent/bead touch index; not caused by that epic.

Bead link writes are unattributable: every `link_added` and `link_removed` event in the bead store records the store owner's email as `actor`, never the acting agent. As a result the touch index's `linked` verb can never appear for any agent (in `sase bead touched` or the Agents-tab `Beads:` sub-section).

Root cause: `BeadProject.add_link` / `remove_link` in `src/sase/bead/_project_mutations_links.py` call `bead_mutation_facade.add_link` / `remove_link` without any actor, so core falls back to the owner. Compare `_project_mutations_snooze.py`, which threads an explicit `actor=` through the same facade layer. The fix likely needs an `actor` parameter on the sase-core link mutation binding (if it lacks one) plus the Python caller resolving the acting agent (globalized, as `sase.bead.attribution.acting_agent_name()` does), falling back to the owner.

task_type_fields.impact: Bead link history cannot say which agent linked what, and the touch index's 'linked' verb is dead for every agent in sase bead touched and the Agents-tab Beads: sub-section.
task_type_fields.repro:
Scan the live store's event streams (verified 2026-09-21 on master da766b87a):

    python3 - "$(sase repo path beads)" <<'PY'
    import json,sys,glob,os,collections
    c=collections.Counter()
    for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(sys.argv[1],'events','streams','*.jsonl')):
        for l in open(p):
            e=json.loads(l)
            if e.get('operation') in ('link_added','link_removed'):
                c[(e['operation'], '@' in (e.get('actor') or ''))]+=1
    print(c)
    PY

Result: link_added 2831/2831 owner-email actors, link_removed 13/13. Any agent running `sase artifact link add bead:<id> ...` or a bead link mutation produces another owner-attributed row.
